html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqich. Avval har kuryerning har kunida nechta buyurtma yetkazilganini sanaymiz. Keyin har kuryerning kunlarini shu son bo'yicha kamayish tartibida tizamiz va birinchisini olamiz. "Har guruhdagi birinchi" savoliga ROW_NUMBER eng qulay javob.

Yechim

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT courier_id, order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY courier_id, order_date
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT courier_id, order_date, orders,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY courier_id
                            ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date) AS rn
  FROM daily
)
SELECT c.id AS courier_id, c.name, r.order_date AS busiest_day, r.orders
FROM ranked r
JOIN couriers c ON c.id = r.courier_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY c.id

Teng kunlar qoidasi oyna ichidagi ORDER BY ning ikkinchi ustunida: son teng bo'lsa, sana o'sish tartibida. Namunadagi Aziz 1-mart va 3-mart kunlari 2 tadan buyurtma yetkazgan, natijada 1-mart.

Tuzoqlar

WHERE status = 'delivered' ni unutsangiz, Azizning 3-marti bekor qilingan buyurtma hisobiga 3 ta bo'lib, birinchi o'ringa chiqadi.

RANK teng kunlarga bir xil o'rin beradi, natijada kuryer uchun ikki qator chiqadi. ROW_NUMBER esa doim bittasini tanlaydi, lekin qaysi birini tanlashni tartib ustunlari aniq aytishi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Oyna funksiyasisiz: har kuryerning eng katta kunlik sonini MAX bilan topib, shu songa teng kunlar ichidan eng kichik sanani olish mumkin.

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT courier_id, order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY courier_id, order_date
),
best AS (
  SELECT courier_id, MAX(orders) AS orders FROM daily GROUP BY courier_id
)
SELECT c.id AS courier_id, c.name, MIN(d.order_date) AS busiest_day, b.orders
FROM best b
JOIN daily d ON d.courier_id = b.courier_id AND d.orders = b.orders
JOIN couriers c ON c.id = b.courier_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, b.orders
ORDER BY c.id
